## Oct 18 Results: Clean Sweep

Let's talk numbers. Yesterday we went 1-0, hitting 100% accuracy on our picks. The model called Rays at 51% confidence in Cleveland, and the data delivered. When you trust the numbers, the numbers trust you back.

## Breaking Down the Win

The Rays pick at 51% was essentially a coin flip with a slight edge. But here's what separates good analysis from gut feelings: we identified that marginal advantage and capitalized. In a one-game slate, 1-0 is the only number that matters.

## Oct 19 Preview: Rays Back Home

Tomorrow we're looking at a rematch with reversed venues. Cleveland travels to Tampa Bay, and the model likes the home team significantly more this time. We're projecting Rays at 58% win probability—a 7 percentage point increase from yesterday's pick.
